data.narrative:
Skeleton Technologies is a Series E climate and energy company that has raised €392M to date across its funding history. The valuation landscape for frontier energy comprises one public comparable (Lanza Tech) and eight private peers operating across battery materials, hydrogen, and critical minerals sectors, though none represent sufficiently tight stage or valuation-tier matches to support peer-median triangulation.

Given the constraint on peer density, stage-progression analysis provides the primary valuation signal. Applying a 1.4x step-up multiplier typical of Series E advancement to the €392M total raised proxy yields €549M. This method rests on the premise that Series E companies command a measurable premium over cumulative capital deployed, adjusted for dilution and mark-to-market conventions observed in frontier energy funding rounds.

The analysis supports a valuation range of €466M to €631M, centered on €549M. Key uncertainties include (1) the applicability of standard stage-progression multiples in frontier energy, where capital intensity and pre-revenue status may compress or expand typical step-ups; (2) the absence of narrow peer comparables limits cross-check validation; and (3) market conditions in deep-tech financing have shifted materially since most comparable rounds closed. A single-method valuation carries elevated model risk and should be refreshed when additional comparable transactions or financial milestones become available.
